name: Mercenary Twinned Arrows
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Twinned Arrows (players/ranger/mercenary/twinned_arrows_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): a new arrow on any primary hit at 35% (Bow Shot arrows split at 40%). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Each primary attack hit, from any weapon, has a 35% chance to fire an arrow for 20 physical damage at another enemy within 175.
